Standing before the Fire, they will wish to be returned and not deny the signs, but if returned they would repeat what was forbidden, for they are liars.
Those who lie about Allah or deny His verses admit disbelief at death, enter the Fire cursing each other, and never enter Paradise until a camel passes a needle's eye.
Those Allah leaves astray are gathered on their faces, blind, dumb and deaf, into an ever-blazing Hell for denying His verses and the resurrection.
They and the devils will be gathered on their knees around Hell, the most insolent of each sect singled out; all will come to it, but the God-fearing are saved.
In Hell the deniers beg to leave, are refused for mocking the believers, say they stayed a day or part of one, and are asked if they were created uselessly.
Those gathered on their faces to Hell are the worst in position and the farthest astray.
Paradise is brought near the righteous and Hellfire to the deviators, who are thrown in with what they worshipped and Iblees' soldiers, confess their error and wish for a return.
Criminals will hang their heads before their Lord begging to return, but Allah will fill Hell with jinn and people, who taste eternal punishment for forgetting this Day.
Allah cursed the disbelievers and prepared an eternal Blaze, where, faces turned in the Fire, they wish they had obeyed and seek double punishment for the leaders who misled them.
Disbelievers in Hell neither die nor find relief, and when they cry to be let out to do good, they are told they had time and a warner.
Criminals will be set apart and reminded that Allah forbade the children of Adam to worship Satan, a clear enemy, and told to burn in the Hellfire they were promised.
The tree of zaqqum rises from the bottom of Hellfire; wrongdoers fill their bellies from it, drink scalding water and return to Hellfire, having hastened after fathers they found astray.
Transgressors have an evil return in Hell, with scalding water and purulence, where followers and leaders quarrel and wonder where the men they ridiculed have gone.
In the Fire the weak ask the arrogant they followed for relief, and all ask Hell's keepers to pray for them, who remind them their messengers brought clear proofs.
The criminals abide in Hell's punishment in despair, calling on Malik to end them, but are told they will remain, having been averse to the truth.
The tree of zaqqum is food for the sinful, boiling in their bellies; the sinner is dragged into Hellfire, scalding water poured on his head, and mocked as 'the honored'.
Woe that Day to the deniers amusing themselves; thrust into Hell, they are asked whether the Fire they denied is magic, and burn, patient or not, for what they did.
The criminals are in error and madness; on the Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces, they will be told to taste the touch of Saqar.
The criminals are known by their marks and seized by forelocks and feet; this is the Hell they denied, where they go between it and scalding water.
The companions of the left, who lived in luxury, persisted in the great violation and doubted being raised, will have scorching fire, scalding water, black smoke and the zaqqum tree.
Believers must guard themselves and their families from a Fire fueled by people and stones, kept by stern angels; disbelievers are told that Day that excuses are useless.
Hell boils and nearly bursts with rage; its keepers ask each company whether a warner came, and they admit they denied him and wish they had listened or reasoned.
Whoever receives his record in his left hand regrets it, his wealth and authority gone; he is chained in Hellfire for disbelief and neglecting to urge feeding the poor.
Hell's Flame, a remover of exteriors, calls whoever turned away and hoarded wealth.
He will be driven into Saqar, which spares nothing and blackens skin, kept by nineteen angels whose number is a trial for disbelievers; the Fire is a warning to humanity.
Allah has prepared chains, shackles and a blaze for the disbelievers.
Deniers will be sent to a three-columned shadow of smoke giving no shade from the flame, which throws sparks as huge as fortresses.
Hell lies in wait for transgressors, who will stay for ages tasting only scalding water and purulence, a fit recompense for denying the account and Allah's verses.
On the Overwhelming Day some faces will be humbled and weary, burning in a hot Fire, drinking from a boiling spring and eating a thorny plant that does not nourish.
Allah warns of a blazing Fire in which only the most wretched, who denied and turned away, will burn.
He will be thrown into the Crusher, Allah's ever-fueled fire that rises over the hearts and closes upon them in extended columns.
